query:

In the college, professors do not perform administrative work, and young doctors under the age of 30 are doing administrative work. Many people in the college are They are recruited from overseas, and they all have doctoral degrees.Li Ming is the youngest professor of the college.He is only 29 years old.

Some professors in the college are not recruited from overseas can be derived based on the above statement.
